title: Decoupling of large-scale, adiabatic inflationary perturbations from enhanced small-scale modes at one-loop
summary: We reconsider back-reaction from large amplitude, short-scale perturbations onto a long wavelength adiabatic mode. In a loop expansion of the long-mode power spectrum, this back-reaction appears first at 1-loop. Due to the separation between the long and short scales, the separate universe method provides a simple and efficient framework for this computation. In this paper, building on our earlier work, we employ a $δN$ formula for the long mode, which captures the effect of short scales.
